Small, hand-written stand-ins for the generator's read-only sources (project `demo`), used by
`test/Dsp.DevOverview.RegistrationGenerator.Tests`. Layout mirrors the real workspace:
`tf/` = Terraform env dir, `repo/` = service repo, `local/` = local-dev/<project>, `current.json` = an existing record
with hand-maintained `overrides`, a manual edge and extra properties the generator must keep.
